Files are the unmodified distribution files from the "leaflet" npm package,
version 1.9.4, except that the trailing "sourceMappingURL" comment was removed
from leaflet.js and leaflet-src.js (source maps are not shipped).

leaflet.js      minified build, loaded on the front end
leaflet-src.js  unminified build, loaded instead when SCRIPT_DEBUG is enabled
